-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.InvWatchSync` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.wsCloser (s st : Loc) (γs : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ stc,
      typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"stopc" s) stc
          DFrac.discard ∗
        mvcc.stopCloser stc ∗ mvcc.wsWaiter s ∗ mvcc.storeCloser st γs)

def mvcc.wsWaiter (s : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γwg γd,
      sync.isWaitGroup (mvcc.wsWgAddr s) γwg mvcc.wsWgWGN ∗
        inv mvcc.wsWgN (mvcc.wsWgInv γwg γd) ∗ sync.ownWaitGroupWaiters γwg 0)

def mvcc.entsEvents (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) : List mvcc.EvM :=
  List.filter (fun ev => mvcc.wgCovers W ev.kv.key) (List.map mvcc.KvEnt.ev ents)

def mvcc.wsWgWGN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"waitGroup"

structure mvcc.KvEnt : Type where
  rev : mvcc.Rev
  tomb : Bool
  kv : EtcdKv

def mvcc.moverRes (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (B : mvcc.EventBatch) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs evsw,
      mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗
        mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗
          mvcc.watcherChan γ w γw st.ch ∗
            mvcc.watcherFilters γw fcs ∗
              ⌜sint.Z r.startRev ≤ ↑γw.lo ∧ ↑γw.lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev ∧ mvcc.victimBatchOk γw.lo st B⌝ ∗
                mvcc.watcherOwn w st (Qp.half 1) ∗
                  monoListAuthOwn γw.evs (Qp.half 1) evsw ∗
                    dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) true ∗
                      mvcc.evsWf γ r γw.lo (evsw ++ B.evs) (sint.nat st.minRev))

def mvcc.logEnts (log : mvcc.Log) (lo hi : Nat) : List mvcc.KvEnt :=
  (List.map (fun m => mvcc.entsOfRev m (mvcc.stateAt log (m - 1)) (List.getD log m []))
      (List.range' lo (hi - lo))).flatten

theorem mvcc.wsWg_maskN : ↑mvcc.wsWgN ⊆ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.wsWgWGN

theorem mvcc.wp_wsDone (s : Loc) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit pkg_id.sync ∗ mvcc.wsDone s -∗ ▷ (True -∗ Φ
    (intoVal ())) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods sync.WaitGroup.ty.PointerType go!"Done" (intoVal
    (mvcc.wsWgAddr s)))) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.KvEnt.ev (e : mvcc.KvEnt) : mvcc.EvM :=
  if e.tomb = true then
    { del := true,
      kv :=
        have __src := e.kv;
        { key := __src.key, createRev := __src.createRev, modRev := e.rev.main, version := __src.version,
          value := __src.value, lease := __src.lease },
      prevKv := none }
  else { del := false, kv := e.kv, prevKv := none }

def mvcc.wsWgAddr [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore go!"wg" s

def mvcc.KvEnt.pair (e : mvcc.KvEnt) : GoString × GoString :=
  (mvcc.revBytes e.rev e.tomb, mvcc.kvEncode e.kv)

def mvcc.wsWgInv (γwg : sync.WaitGroupNames) (γd : GName) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ctr n, sync.ownWaitGroup γwg ctr ∗ ownTokAuth γd n ∗ ⌜sint.Z ctr = ↑n⌝)

def mvcc.wgCovers (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (k : GoString) : Bool :=
  decide (∃ w r, W !! w = some r ∧ r.covers k = true)

def mvcc.entsOfRev (r : Nat) (before : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : List mvcc.KvEnt :=
  List.filterMap
    (fun p =>
      Option.map (fun kv => { rev := { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑p.snd }, tomb := p.fst.isDel, kv := kv })
        (mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑r) before cs p.snd))
    cs.zipIdx

def mvcc.wsWgN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"wgCounter"

theorem mvcc.wsWg_maskW : ↑mvcc.wsWgWGN ⊆ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.wsWgN

def mvcc.wsDone (s : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γwg γd,
      sync.isWaitGroup (mvcc.wsWgAddr s) γwg mvcc.wsWgWGN ∗ inv mvcc.wsWgN (mvcc.wsWgInv γwg γd) ∗ ownToks γd 1)
